summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Commerce to establish at least three regional, nonprofit, open-access technology maturation facilities to help scale up and commercialize bioindustrial processes and products in the United States.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly authorizes appropriations totaling $345,000,000 for fiscal years 2026-2028 and $117,000,000 for fiscal years 2029-2030 to establish and operate bioindustrial technology maturation facilities. This direct authorization of funds for new government programs and facilities represents a clear increase in government spending.
